player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Player {player_id} mu mukino wa Chopsticks. Mu gihe cy'ukwe, hitamo mo kimwe ku:
  + Arataka:  '[attack M O]'  where M=igobe ryawe (0 or 1), O=igobe ry'abapfuye (0 or 1).
    - Igobe ry'abapfuye kizongera kubera igobe ryawe; ikiyongera 5, kizaba 0.
  + Tandukana:   '[split L R]'  ukoreshe igobe ryawe ryose muri L na R (L+R = igobe ryawe ryose).
Wandanike mo kimwe ku mafunguro yaliyo hapo juu.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Split igomba kuba ihindura uburyo ibiganza byawe bitangwamo.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Ikibazo siyo sahihi. Utumie “[attack M O]” au “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} arataka igobe ry'a P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: ryagenda kuva {opp_val} kugera {new_val}.
